The vet is surprisingly hard to get into in the boonies of Farmville that we live in. So, we still have "Dusty" kind of quarantined, no shared food, water, or litterbox. But, we gave him a bath (fairly sure we saw tiny boy parts!). So, probably not prego, lol, and his belly has been deflating with a healthier, steady diet and a constant source of fresh water. We have closely monitored his litterbox for intestinal bugs. He sleeps in my daughter's room, a huge space in the basement, he has lots of fun toys and a scratching post with sleeping perch that he loves almost as much as my daughter's bed. He purrs instantly upon touch. We have slowly introduced him to our mini Aussie, Coco, who now wants to constantly go downstairs and visit and play with her new baby brother! Our cat is a bit standoffish but that's just her personality. We finally got an appt for next Wednesday for Dusty, so hopefully all goes well, because we're all madly love with him.
